subject: general
question: In 2023, which institution implemented two-factor authentication for all e-way bill and e-invoice systems?
solution: The correct answer is __**CBIC**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** • CBIC stands for Central Board of Indirect Taxes and Customs. • CBIC is a part of the Department of Revenue under the Ministry of Finance in India. • It is responsible for the administration of indirect taxes such as Goods and Services Tax (GST), Customs, and Central Excise. • CBIC also plays a crucial role in preventing smuggling and enforcing trade laws and regulations. • The board is headed by a Chairperson and has several members who oversee different departments and functions related to indirect taxes and customs.
